rationale: Bill's deep conviction in LLM efficiency, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and real-time AI perception aligns with Georgi's focus on building agentic systems that automate GTM workflows—both are exploring how to make LLMs practical and performant at scale. Georgi is actively hiring for GTM execution and runs hackathons to surface builders; Bill, as a YC P26 founder shipping applied ML products, could benefit from Georgi's distribution network and GTM expertise to get General Instinct in front of the right early-stage teams.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Georgi—you're both building in the LLM-agents space from different angles, and Georgi's actively hiring and running events to find builders like you.
